mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(cl.credit), 0) from aem_grade_record gr left join tpm_course_library cl on gr.course_id = cl.course_id where gr.student_id = #{studentId} and gr.semester_id = #{semesterId} and gr.is_pass = '1' and gr.status = '0'
select student_id from sam_student where status = '0' order by student_id limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(1) from sam_student where status = '0'
